title.analysis: I Investigated 8 Ways to Build Wealth (Only 3 Actually Work). First-person research authority plus elimination/count curiosity; promises a decision filter, not simply another wealth list. Search relevance to wealth-building methods and index funds is semantic, with no measured volume. Script distinguishes extreme success from typical outcomes but provides no complete comparative eight-method dataset. Investigated is a narrator claim, not independent research certification.
title.script_alignment: Eight numbered sections delivered: day trading, crypto, property hacks, side hustles, dividend chasing, index funds, income growth, savings rate. Actual thumbnail classifications and categories differ materially.

thumbnail.analysis: Verified 1280x720 image: stern cartoon man pointing at eight labeled circles beneath 5 ARE LIES. Red crosses: REAL ESTATE, CRYPTO, DROPSHIPPING, CAR FLIPPING, DAY TRADING. Green checks: INDEX FUNDS, DIVIDENDS, SMALL BIZ. Black curved arrow points to dividends. Main headline readable at320px; small labels require more effort. Most material observation: dividend investing is checked as winner, while script explicitly rejects dividend chasing as fifth losing method. Small business, car flipping and dropshipping replace script income/savings/side-hustle categories. Property crossed broadly despite script spare-room exception. Strong visual sorting is an interpretation; actual impact unknown. URL association confirms fetched asset only, not historical upload thumbnail.
thumbnail.content_correspondence: Material category/classification mismatch, especially DIVIDENDS green check versus script rejecting dividend chasing; no historical-change timeline available.
thumbnail.performance_effect: UNKNOWN; no CTR, impressions, retention or experiment

script.analysis: Full17252-character stored transcript read in five contiguous chunks. Hook contrasts same-salary coworkers Kristoff/Anna and promises a100k gap explanation. Ceiling-versus-median framing organizes five rejected routes then three endorsed levers. Repeated pitch→research/anecdote→hidden cost→verdict gives clear progression; the five-negative trough resolves into index/income/savings mechanism. Returns to barbecue characters, then reveals narrator faceless-finance channel as income model and promotes a school community/playbook. This commercial endpoint matters when weighing anti-guru/no-one-sells-boring framing. Unverified coworkers and claimed personal investigation are illustrative testimony, not authenticated outcomes. Personal story blends index deposits, raises and room rent, preventing attribution of100k gap to passivity alone.

claim_audit.assessment: Ex-dividend reference-price adjustment/totalreturn logic broadly useful, but market price moves with other news and tax depends account/jurisdiction/qualified status; tax-deferred holdings do not automatically owe current dividend income tax.

topic.analysis: Wealth-method selection for US retail beginners attracted to trading, crypto, property and passive-income stories. Economic engine is income minus spending invested in diversified low-cost assets. Distinguishing median outcomes from success anecdotes is useful but mixes asset choices, labor income and savings behavior as if mutually exclusive methods. Search/browse utility plausible; no demand volume or audience analytics.
topic.novelty_and_corpus_angle: Five-losers/three-winners sorting and returning coworkers make a coherent explainer; the creator-community sales pivot supplies an identifiable incentive and requires the same median-outcome scrutiny applied to gurus.
